# langfuse_score_config (Data Source)

Look up a score config by name, for example to reference it from an annotation queue. Archived score configs are ignored; the lookup fails unless exactly one active score config has the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "langfuse_score_config" "accuracy" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "accuracy"
}

output "accuracy_score_config_id" {
  value = data.langfuse_score_config.accuracy.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the score config.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Read-Only

- `categories` (Attributes List) The categories of a categorical or boolean score config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories))
- `data_type` (String) The data type: `NUMERIC`, `CATEGORICAL`, `BOOLEAN`, or `TEXT`.
- `description` (String) The description of the score config.
- `id` (String) The score config ID.
- `max_value` (Number) The maximum value of a numeric score config.
- `min_value` (Number) The minimum value of a numeric score config.

<a id="nestedatt--categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `categories`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) The category label.
- `value` (Number) The numeric value of the category.
